intents.description: User is greeting the chatbot at the start of a conversation.
responses: Hello! How can I help you today?
Hi there! What would you like to talk about?
Hey! Good to see you. What's on your mind?

intents.description: User wants to end the conversation.
responses: Goodbye! Have a great day.
See you later! Feel free to come back anytime.
Bye! It was nice chatting with you.

intents.description: User asks for the chatbot's name or identity.
responses: I'm an AI chatbot built for an internship project. You can just call me Chatbot!
I don't have a fancy name, but I'm your friendly AI assistant for this project.

intents.description: User asks what the chatbot is able to do.
examples: what can you help me with
responses: I can chat with you, answer questions about AI and Python, remember your name, and hold a natural multi-turn conversation.
I can answer questions, remember context from earlier in our chat, and have a normal back-and-forth conversation with you.

intents.description: User asks a question about artificial intelligence in general.
responses: Artificial Intelligence is the field of building computer systems that can perform tasks normally requiring human intelligence, like understanding language or recognizing patterns.
AI refers to software that can learn from data or follow rules to make decisions, rather than being explicitly programmed step by step for every situation.

intents.description: User asks a question about the Python programming language.
examples: what can python be used for
what can i use python for
responses: Python is a beginner-friendly programming language known for its simple syntax. It's widely used for web development, automation, data science, and AI.
Python is popular because it's easy to read and has libraries for almost everything, from building websites to training AI models.

intents.description: User asks how chatbots in general (or this chatbot) work.
responses: Chatbots usually work by recognizing the intent behind a message, then generating or selecting an appropriate response. This one combines simple keyword-based intent recognition with the Gemini API for natural replies.
A chatbot like me looks for patterns in what you type to figure out what you mean, then uses that understanding to craft a helpful reply.

intents.description: User is asking for help or guidance.
responses: Sure, I'm here to help! You can ask me about AI, Python, or chatbots, or just have a casual conversation.
Of course! Tell me what you're trying to do and I'll do my best to help.
You're welcome!
Happy to help!
Anytime! Let me know if you need anything else.
I'm doing well, thanks for asking! How about you?
I'm just here ready to chat. What's going on with you?

intents.description: User tells the chatbot their own name, which should be remembered.
responses: Nice to meet you! I'll remember your name.

intents.description: User asks the chatbot to recall the name they previously gave.
responses: Let me check what you told me earlier.
